main_text.p: quod μετ' ὀλίγον, id est, paulo post futu-rū uocatur: id efficitur ex secunda perso-na perfecti, uerso αι in ομαι, τέτυ-φαι τετύ-φομαι, mox cædar, uel iam cæsus sum.
Mox uer-berabor, uel iā uer-beratus sum.De modis alijs.

Cæterum perfectū, quia nec in ομαι, nec ῳ finit, obseruandum est.
main_text.head: IMPERATIVVS.
main_text.l: τύπτε τύπτετο uel τύπτου, τυπτέσθω Verbera re.
